Teeka package ya .bpk okulaba pulogulaamu wano.
Kino kijjamu fayiro za pulogulaamu eziteekeddwa. Data ey’ekyama ne logs bisigala osobole okubizzaawo; bisangule mu Program Manager oba File Explorer.
Londa folda y’okuteekebwamu munda mu Bluebird Storage. Bluebird ejja kutondawo folda ya puloguramu yokka.
Obumanyirivu bwa launcher ey’ekika kya desktop ku Android
Launcher ey’omulembe ey’ekika kya desktop eya Android, etegekeddwa okukozesebwa omulundi ogusooka mu ngeri ennongoofu era ey’amangu.
Bluebird ejja kukulungamya mu nsengeka z’okuyingira n’ez’ebikukwatako. Ggwe okuuma obuyinza ku lukusa lwonna.
Kiganya app za Bluebird okunoonya media bw’olonda okukozesa ebintu ebyo.
Kikozesebwa okulaga ebifuga okuzannya media n’okuzza obuggya ennyimba mu butegeeza ng’okozesa ekizannya media.
Okuyingira mu butereke okw’omutindo ogwa waggulu (si kwa buwaze) okuddukanya fayiro mu ngeri ya desktop n’emirimu gya fayiro ez’omu kyuma.
Olukusa luno si lwa buwaze. Awatali lwo, ebimu ebikwata ku %1$s tebijja kubaawo. Osobola okuluwa oluvannyuma mu Nsengeka za Android.
Okuyingira mu %1$s kwetaagibwa ku bikulu. Nsaba okuwe mu Nsengeka za Android okweyongerayo.
Bluebird ejja kusaba buli lukusa lumu ku limu. Daamu obubaka bwa sisitemu bwe bulabika. Okuyingira okutali kwa buwaze kuyinza okuyitibwako ne kuteekebwawo oluvannyuma okuva mu Nsengeka za Android.
Liragibwa ku lupapula lwo olw’okukuuma ne ku mbaga ey’oku lupapula olusooka. Osobola okulikyusa oluvannyuma mu Nsengeka.
Londa ekifaananyi okuva mu gallery yo. Bluebird teetaaga kuyingira mu kamera ku kifaananyi kyo.
Bluebird ejja kukozesa olulimi lw’ekyuma kyo bwokka, oba osobola okulonda olulala.
Browser ennyangu eri mu Bluebird OS
Kitereddwa mu data ya Bluebird ey’ekyama. App endala tezisobola kulaba ffolda eno; kozesa ekipande kino okukebera oba okusangula fayiro.
Obusobozi obuweereddwa wano bwokka bwe buyinza okukozesebwa ku API ya BPK eya Bluebird.

.bpk ye fayiro ya ZIP eyatuumibwa erinnya eppya erya .bpk. Kuuma amakubo n’amannya nga bwe gali:
Manifest erina okulaga ku fayiro entuufu mu app/. Ekkubo ly’ekifaananyi (icon) erina okulaga ku PNG eri mu paketi. Tereka fayiro za app mu paketi era weewale amakubo amaziba oba ../.

Kikulu: okukyusa olukusa tekikakasa nti buli kintu kya browser ekikwatagana kikuumiddwa mu sandbox. Laga JavaScript bridge eri BPK ey’omu kyuma kyokka eyesigika, era kebera enneeyisa ya network ne media mu mbeera entuufu.

Osobola okusaba AI okukola app entono ntuuyo, n’oluvannyuma n’oteeka fayiro zaayo nga okozesa enkola eri waggulu. Teekamu omulagirizo oguli wansi mu kusaba kwo, omuyambi amanye manifest ne bridge API ya Bluebird.
Ebikola zoom n’okulaga biri ku lubaawo lw’ebikozesebwa
Browser ya Bluebird ekuumibwa nga ntono ku bugenderevu: okunoonya, tabu, obulambe, ebyafaayo n’ebiwanuddwa.
Wandiika ekifo ky’ekintu, oba noonya fayiro oba ffolda.
Desktop ejjudde. Ebimu bikyaliwo mu Desktop.

Kwata app olonde Yongera ku Start
Entandikwa ya app si ntuufu. Kebera okussaako n’ebiwandiiko bya app.
Kifuule Bluebird launcher yo eya bulijjo, bbaatuuni ya Home etuddeyo wano buli kiseera.
Yongera ebifaananyi ku kyuma kyo, n’oluvannyuma zza obuggya library.
Ebifaananyi ebirondeddwa bijja kuggyibwa ku kyuma.
Ekitegeera ebifaananyi ekitunuulidde, nga kirina okutambulira mu ngeri ya desktop.
Bluebird yeetaaga bifaananyi byokka. Ku Android ezisoboza, osobola okulonda ebifaananyi by’ogabana.
Kkiriza Bluebird Photos okuyingira ebifaananyi byo

BPK ekyusa pulojekiti ya web okufuuka app Bluebird gy’eyinza okussaako, okutegeera, okutandika, okukuuma n’okuggyawo. Zimba interface ne HTML, CSS ne JavaScript, n’oluvannyuma teeka pulojekiti nga fayiro ya .bpk.
Ekikyusa ekifaananyi eky’emabega ekiteetambula n’ekiggyako entambula z’obuntu
Kuba kimu okukikozesa, oba yongera ekirala okuva mu gallery yo.
Yongera ebifaananyi eby’emabega mu res/drawable\nnga desktop_wp_1.png, desktop_wp_2.png, …
Londa kimu oba ebisingawo. Bwe wabaawo ebisukka mu kimu, bikyuka bokka buli ssaawa.

Network access. Only grant this to apps that genuinely need remote content or services.

The BPK update client can check an HTTPS feed, download a package, verify its SHA-256 hash, and stage an update. The host should ask the user before installing it.
Apps can write diagnostic messages, and runtime errors may be recorded for review in Program Manager. Logs can be cleared there.
Apps can keep small key/value settings in their own private data directory when App Storage is granted. Use Program Manager or File Explorer to inspect supported data files.
Review each app’s capabilities in Program Manager. Grant only what the app needs, and revoke grants you no longer want.
